Title: Public Preview: Enterprise MCP enhancements in Foundry Agent Service

Body.Content:
Microsoft Foundry has enhanced integration to Enterprise MCP to enable secure, authenticated connections to MCP servers, allowing credentials to be passed to MCP servers securely. These updates enable enhanced flexibility, security, and compliance when integrating MCP with Microsoft Foundry.

Learn more.
